subject.title: fix: protect SMS webhook callback quota [AI]

question: Should unauthenticated SMS webhook traffic be allowed at 300 requests per minute per account-route-client key before the signed 30-request quota applies?
rationale: Quota separation fixes the starvation bug, but increasing unsigned parsing and signature work tenfold is a deliberate security and availability policy choice that cannot be settled by CI or contributor proof alone.

options.title: Approve the 300/30 split
options.body: Keep the proposed thresholds and update the SMS security documentation before merge.

options.title: Lower the pre-validation budget
options.body: Preserve separate quotas but select a smaller unauthenticated threshold and align tests, proof, and documentation.

options.title: Retain the single quota
options.body: Decline this approach and continue allowing invalid shared-proxy traffic to consume valid callback capacity.

recommendation.title: Approve the 300/30 split
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed thresholds and update the SMS security documentation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The SMS webhook and its existing security contract originate from this person's merged feature work.
